selections.heading: Corrections
selections.text: For local Compose acceptance, describe transaction durability as atomic effects and committed-state survival within existing volumes; do not claim zero data loss after host or volume destruction unless WAL or replication mechanisms exist.

selections.heading: Corrections
selections.text: Use explicit local tokens and least-privilege roles only under the local profile, and fail every non-local profile until W2-01 authenticated identity and transport controls are implemented.
